newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eurodisney opens lower after results.
newsitem.headline: Eurodisney opens lower after results.

text.p: Shares in theme park operator Eurodisney opened at 11.35 francs, down from its closing price of 11.45 francs on Monday.
The company reported profits of 202 million francs for the 1995/1996 year, at the top end of expectations.
But the company's chairman said that next year would be a challenge.

"Persistent weakness in the economy, constant pressure on our prices and the strong increaes in financial charges constitute several real challenges for the future, particularly in 1997," Philippe Bourguignon said in a statement.
At 0910 GMT, Eurodisney shares were down 1.31 percent at 11.30 francs in volume of 423,319 shares.
